authority_scope: The six-dimensional kernel is exact for one clamp-inactive 2x2 block at the post-resize PoseNet RGB read surface. Seg-visible means nonzero RGB reaches SegNet input, not that SegNet argmax changes. The measured uint8 fraction is scorer-grid-fixture only; camera-grid preimage and receiver-closed realization remain fail-closed.

exact_kernel.domain: four RGB perturbations delta_p in one 2x2 scorer-grid block
constraints: for every phase pixel p: 299 delta_R[p] + 587 delta_G[p] + 114 delta_B[p] = 0
exact_kernel.equivalent_pose_constraints: delta Y00=delta Y10=delta Y01=delta Y11=0 and boxmean(delta U)=boxmean(delta V)=0
exact_kernel.parameterization: Choose four (u_p,v_p) chroma coordinates with sum_p u_p=sum_p v_p=0. Map each to RGB by delta_R=1.402 v, delta_B=1.772 u, delta_G=-(0.299*1.402 v + 0.114*1.772 u)/0.587.
exact_kernel.integer_primitive_certificate: 299*(-15) + 587*9 + 114*(-7) = 0; put +primitive on one phase and -primitive on another phase.
exact_kernel.seg_visibility: SegNet consumes the second-frame post-resize RGB tensor directly, so every nonzero kernel element is visible on its RGB input surface.

uint8_readback.procedure: Bilinear-resize the 12 n6 camera frames to 384x512 using the source-bound align_corners=False matrix; round to a uint8 scorer-grid fixture; in each 2x2 block select the first directed phase pair for which +/-[-15,9,-7] stays in [0,255]; read back the float32 YUV6 law.
uint8_readback.admission_rule: j8f, pa2, and F2 may consume the exact real kernel. They must use bit_exact_yuv6_fraction_among_feasible for this scoped scorer-grid uint8 fixture and must refuse camera-level zero-Pose-cost authority while camera_preimage_certified_fraction is null.

source_receipts.role: #580 resize geometry and the requirement to separate real nullity from bounded uint8 realization
